text:
raj: Kicking off a focused pattern-scan sync for last quarter. Found 5 repeating failure signatures we should convert into playbooks: 1) autoscaler overshoot leading to spike-induced queuing, 2) model-swap latency (KV warmup gaps), 3) KV cache eviction storms during batch inference, 4) DB pool exhaustion during analytics windows, 5) release script param drift (canary percent misapplied). Planning owners + short timelines here.

emily: Nice. For model-swap latency I want to test a small overlay of warm-only _hot_ instances for top-10 models, and telemetry to trace KV-miss lifecycles.

mike: Autoscaler overshoot is tricky; we've seen it happen when node drain and autoscale triggers overlap. Suggest adding a cooldown window and rate-limited scale-up.

alice: Release script drift 1I've got a local repro where a default env var gets overwritten. I'll add stricter parsing and a CI lint to block weird defaults.

clara: DB pool exhaustion correlates with the nightly analytics spike at ~03:20 UTC. Quick mitigation: stagger heavy queries and pin analytics to read replicas. Longer term: improve connection pooling and backpressure.

raj: Proposed items (short):
- P1: Autoscaler cooldown + rate limit, owner: mike, due: 2026-04-12
- P2: Model-swap warm overlay + KV lifecycle tracing, owner: emily, due: 2026-04-30
- P3: KV eviction monitoring + adaptive LRU claims, owner: raj, due: 2026-05-07
- P4: Analytics window shift + read-replica pin, owner: clara, due: 2026-04-09
- P5: Release script lint + default-proofing, owner: alice, due: 2026-04-05

mike: Will draft the autoscaler cooldown RFC. Quick question: do we want cooldowns per deployment or cluster-wide?

emily: Per deployment + global floor. Some services need quicker scale than others.

alice: PR incoming for release script lint: https://github.com/redwood/release-scripts/pull/618 1I added tests for env defaults.

raj: Splunk query I used to enumerate these (90d):
```
index=prod_logs service=inference | stats count by failure_signature, deployment | sort -count
```
The autoscaler signature was top across infra incidents.

ops-bot: Created playbook seeds: REC-2401 (autoscaler cooldown), REC-2402 (model warm overlay), REC-2403 (kv-eviction), REC-2404 (analytics-window), REC-2405 (release-lint). Assigned to listed owners.

oncall-bot: Heads up: add any ongoing incident refs to the recurrence tracker page https://redwood.internal/incidents/recurrence-catalog to keep lineage.

clara: I'll coordinate with data-platform on the analytics shift tomorrow. tagging @data-platform leads in the agenda.

mike: pairing ask 1I need a hand designing the scale-up rate limiter. Who can review?

emily: I can take 30m tomorrow.

alice: Lint PR is currently flagged by CI for a flake, fixing now. ETA 2h.

raj: On the playbook format: let's include detection rules (alerts + thresholds), runbook steps, rollback criteria, and postmortem link. I'll start a template under docs/recurrence-playbooks/.

mike: Will add a metric-based alert: if queue depth increases by 150% vs baseline AND scale-ups > 3 in 10m, trigger paging.

emily: Also add a KV-miss rate KPI and a trace link to the model-swap span.

ops-bot: REC-2401 updated with Mike's initial checklist.

raj: Please ack ownership here once you have tickets/PRs linked in the recurrence-catalog. We'll review progress in the monthly incident patterns review on 2026-04-22.

mike: ack (REC-2401).

emily: ack (REC-2402, JIRA-7520 created).

alice: ack (PR 618 soon).

clara: ack (REC-2404, coordinating with data-platform).

raj: Thanks all. I'll follow up with a short digest and the playbook skeleton by EOD. :eyes:
